description: This Dart source file defines the MatchRepository class, which acts as an intermediary between the application's filtering preferences and the MatchService. It converts filter preferences into query parameters and delegates data fetching to the service.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository responsible for translating FilterPreferences into query parameters and delegating calls to MatchService. Encapsulates the mapping logic for filters.

methods.name: MatchRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with a MatchService instance.

methods.name: fetchMatches
methods.description: Fetches matches based on the provided FilterPreferences, converting them into query parameters.

methods.name: _mapFilters
methods.description: Converts FilterPreferences into a map of query string parameters for backend API.
